description: See a range as an image: SheetXL renders the session's current workbook in a headless Chrome or Edge and returns a PNG — values as formatted, fills, fonts, borders, column widths, `#####` where a value does not fit, the saved selection. Use it to check what a person would see, above all after formatting or building a chart; the read tools remain the way to learn values and formulas. Headers are on by default so you can map the picture back to A1. A range larger than `max_edge` is cut at the last whole row or column and the result says where. This is a render of the workbook, not of the user's window: it does not show their scroll position or unsaved edits in a cell editor. On a machine without Chrome or Edge it says so and nothing else changes.

range.description: Range to render, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:H40". Omit for the active sheet's used range.

session_id.description: Target session id, from `info` or `list_sessions`. Required.
